answers.description: A toolkit for processing volumetric CT data to extract and flatten surfaces of ancient documents
answers.problem: Ancient scrolls and manuscripts are too fragile to physically unroll, requiring virtual unwrapping from CT scans
target_users: Digital humanities teams and archaeologists with CT scan data
key_goals: Provide both GUI and CLI tools for the full segmentation-to-texture pipeline
Produce high-quality, readable texture images from CT volumes of ancient scrolls
Maintain a modular, extensible C++ library for algorithm research and development
design_principles: Modularity — algorithms are swappable, pipeline is composable
Performance first — CT volumes are large, efficiency matters
answers.storage: Custom .volpkg directory format (JSON metadata + TIFF slices)
